thesis: The only Stage-90 loss-cap breach crossed the weekly market closure. Preserve the USD 300 bounded canary, but flatten at the last executable completed minute before a greater-than-24-hour native tape gap and suppress re-entry until the next original V18 admission.
unchanged: all 338 V18 source admissions, directions, routes, and original handoff intervals
daily maintenance exposure and every ordinary intraday/GTH/RTH minute
raw-turn risk reduction, one-bar maturation, failed-auction memory, and roll ownership

overlay.weekly_closure_law: if the next native matched MCL minute is more than 24 hours away and the unchanged source position crosses that gap, flatten at the current completed-minute close
overlay.post_flatten_law: remain broker-flat until the next unchanged original V18 admission

limitations: The 24-hour distinction is categorical weekly/holiday closure detection, not a fitted price threshold.
A historical pass opens runtime safety implementation and fresh broker preview only; it grants no selection, capital, order, or profitability authority.
An exceptional intraweek halt or gap may still exceed the cap and remains subject to broker and account safety checks.
